title: Jhukae baithe hai sar ko
body:
Jhukaae baithe hai sar ko abid har ek tasweere gham bana
Rabaab ek ek se poochti hai meri sakina ko kya hua hai
Hai iski gardan dhali hui kyu, paseena maathe pa kyu hai iske
Koi bataata nahi hai mujhko, har ek aansu baha raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye aaqar itni qamosh kyu hai, padi hai ghash me ke so rahi hai
Ye ek qamosh ho gayi kya, har ek qamosh ho gaya hai
Mai maa hu sabr aaye mujhko kyu'n kar, kaleja aata hai muh ko mere
Jo mere dil par guzar rahi hai, kisi ko iski qabar hi kya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dua koi padh ke dam karo is, pe isko quraan ki hawa do
koi quda ke lie kare kuch, ke ab mera dam nikal raha hai
Bulaao abbas ko bulaao , wahi manaalenge isko aakar
chacha hi behtar samajh sakenge, bhateeji ab kis liye qafa hai
